The speaker acknowledges potential losses while citing audits and a zero-fraud history as reassurance.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary mechanism is a funded-contract trading workflow: users deposit assets into the DeFi Boost wallet, configure directional trades and expiries, and are told they can receive rapid payouts when their predictions are correct.

evidence.observation: The speaker attributes a 70% to 400% return claim to the platform's trading activity.
evidence.quote: what it allows traders to do is to generate anywhere between seventy percent to four hundred percent ROI within the time that they specify this.

evidence.observation: The speaker mentions a demo account and invites listeners to try the platform.
evidence.quote: we have a demo account. It is... You can see the chain link icon there as well. So, you know, it's a verified price lead and give it a shot, see if you like it.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes users configuring long or short trades, expiry, and risk level.
evidence.quote: they structure our trade long or short on any underlying asset, and they will say when it should expire and also what level of risk they want to take.

evidence.observation: The speaker links depositing into the DeFi Boost wallet with trading in underlying markets.
evidence.quote: You deposit in the Dei boost wallet. you trade in the underlying markets.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes an 80% token-denominated payout when the directional prediction is correct.
evidence.quote: if you are right, you would be paying out 80% instantly, but in chain link.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that users can choose how much they will lose if the trade expires unsuccessfully.
evidence.quote: if, when it expires, they have not won the trade, then they can choose how much they wish to lose.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that U.S. citizens are not accepted and attributes access restrictions to KYC and regulatory requirements.
evidence.quote: US citizens are not accepted because we are all about the KYC all about the regulations
